source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.3 with Examples 11.1 to 11.3 (PDF 253-255 and 257-258).

blocks.text: Theory of relativity yeh batati hai ke ek doosre ke relative (muqable mein) different (alag alag) motion (harkat) wale observers physical events (waqiaat) ko kaise bayan karte hain. Special theory of relativity sirf inertial (bina acceleration wale) frames ke problems (masail) dekhti hai. Ek aur theory, general theory of relativity, un frames ke problems dekhti hai jo ek doosre ke relative accelerate kar rahe hon. Special theory do postulates (basic maani hui baaton) par khari hai:

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Torch (flashlight) se nikalne wali light ki speed c do observers ek hi naapte hain: ek jo car mein speed v se chal raha hai, aur doosra jo sarak par khara hai.

blocks.alt: Shaam ko sarak par surkh car; us ki headlight aage roshni phenkti hai jis par teer ke saath c likha hai. Aage sarak par ek aadmi roshni mein khara hai. Sarak ke kinare street lamps.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 253): chalti car wala aur sarak par khara aadmi, dono car ki roshni ki speed ek hi c naapte hain (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Physics ke laws tamam inertial frames mein ek jaise hain (Principle of Relativity).
Khali space (free space) mein light ki speed har observer ke liye ek hi hai, chahe source ya observer kaise bhi chal rahe hon (Principle of Constancy of Light).

blocks.text: Pehla postulate yeh baat general (aam) karta hai ke ek doosre ke relative uniform velocity se chalne wale frames mein physics ke saare laws ek jaise hain. Agar laws alag hote to observers bata sakte ke kaun ruka hai aur kaun chal raha hai. Magar aisa koi farq mojood nahi; yani absolute (bilkul) uniform motion ka pata lagane ka koi tareeqa nahi.

Doosra postulate yeh experimental fact (tajurbe se sabit baat) hai ke khali space mein light ki speed ek universal constant hai, jise c likhte hain (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). Chunke c constant hai, is liye space aur time relative ban jate hain. Misal: agar aap light ki speed ke qareeb uniform velocity se chalti train mein baithe hon aur bazu bhar ke faasle par aaina (mirror) pakrein, to aap ko apna reflection (aks) phir bhi nazar aayega. Wajah: principle of relativity ke mutabiq koi experiment (tajurba) andar baithe shakhs ke liye train ki constant motion ka pata nahi laga sakta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “light ki speed par chalti train”. Koi material cheez, jaise train, kabhi light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakti, kyun ke c ke qareeb us ka mass infinite (be-hadd) tak barhta hai (isi topic ka mass wala formula). Sahi baat: light ki speed ke qareeb uniform velocity se chalti train.

In saada postulates ke results (nateeje) bohat door tak jate hain. In mein ghariyon ka ahista chalna aur chalte frames mein length (lambai) ka chhota hona shamil hai, jaisa ruka hua observer dekhta hai. Special theory ke kuch interesting (dilchasp) results, hisab mein jaye baghair, yeh hain.
